title: Shared-kernel envelope contracts and catalog reference integrity

independence.cross_vendor_exception: Not satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register permits a single-vendor fallback only as an explicit recorded exception. Five separate runs with distinct capability declarations, none reviewing its own work, is that fallback - it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review, and runs sharing a vendor and a model share a correlated blind spot.

required_human_authorities: Product Owner disposition of RFC-2026-004 before the manual merge described in RFC-2026-002
purpose: Close defect D3 - two committed catalog $refs that resolve to a path which does not exist, on the two Candidate envelopes that carry every domain event and background job - behind a standing CI guard, and materialize three Draft shared-kernel contracts from the Sprint 0A baseline without inventing contract semantics or advancing any freeze level.

include: A standing catalog reference-integrity guard: every external $ref resolves on disk, no $ref escapes the catalog, every manifest-declared file exists, every fixture on disk is declared
Correction of the two broken tenant_context $refs in CTR-EVT-001 and CTR-JOB-001, recorded in-file
CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001 and CTR-IDM-001 schema, manifest and synthetic valid/invalid fixtures
Deterministic acceptance and negative-case tests for all three new contracts
exclude: Contract freeze-level advancement, contract-catalog/shared-kernel/index.json, production schema, migrations, RLS implementation, provider SDKs, credentials, customer data, network calls, Gate G0 approval and any merge authorization

contracts_produced: CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001, CTR-IDM-001 materialized at Draft only; no freeze-level advancement

authorized_cross_package_amendments: contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-evt-001/schema.json - correct tenant_context $ref from ../../ctr-ten-001/schema.json to ../ctr-ten-001/schema.json and record x-amended-by (RFC-2026-004 decision 2). Corrective, not anticipatory: the reference is broken today.
ownership.forbidden_paths_note: The globs **/*secret* and **/*credential* were removed. A contract catalog that models secret HANDLES must name them, and this package ships contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-mod-001/examples/valid-blocked-missing-secret.json and invalid-secret-handle-shape.json -- both matching a glob this manifest declared forbidden. The contradiction was found by the run authoring WP-0A-CON-004 and confirmed: the ownership validator checks writable and read-only paths but never compares forbidden_paths against declared outputs, so nothing caught it. Replaced with extensions that carry actual key material (*.pem, *.key, *.p12, *.pfx), which is what the rule was for. A filename is not a secret; a private key file is.

amends_without_owning.rationale: This branch changes four open_blockers in this package's own manifest and the handoff that cites them -- both owned outright. The branch-to-package mapping is pinned whole in a test, so renaming this package's branch moves one row there, where it appears in a diff. The integrity manifest records the digests of the protected files this branch edits. No floor is lowered and nothing leaves the protected set.

acceptance_criteria: Every fixture is validated against its OWN shipped schema.json by a dependency-free JSON Schema subset validator, not by a hand-written predicate. An unknown schema keyword is an error, so a schema can never appear to constrain something nothing enforces.

Every rule in every schema traces to a named baseline line, is declared in-schema as an inference from named sources, or is recorded as an accepted gap. No rule is presented as sourced when it is not.
A $ref resolves to the contract it CLAIMS, not merely to a file that exists: tenant_context must resolve to CTR-TEN-001 and error to CTR-ERR-001.

The reference-integrity guard walks every catalog root and every JSON file, rejects a directory target, a scheme-qualified or escaping reference, a declaration outside its own contract directory, and a case-differing path that would pass locally and fail on a case-sensitive runner.

Reference fields use an allow-listed scheme AND a constrained body: a leading slash, any `..` segment, an empty segment and a protocol-relative authority are all rejected. The earlier criterion claimed traversal was rejected while the body permitted `.` and `/` freely, so result:../../../etc/passwd and content://attacker.example.invalid/exfil were accepted. That claim was false as shipped.
Every rule a manifest states as materialized is exercised by a test, and any claim fixtures cannot demonstrate is declared in untestable_by_fixture.
A fixture the contract knowingly accepts is named accepted-gap- and carries a required explanation in accepted_gaps.
The index still reports 4 Candidate and 10 Draft: materializing a Draft contract does not promote it.
The cross-package correction is limited to the two $ref literals plus an x-amended-by record and changes no field, semantics, version or freeze level.
npm run check passes on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0 with skipped and todo both zero.
The acceptance predicate may not enforce any shape rule the schema does not state. Proven per fixture, with a witness fixture using a non-sha256 algorithm so the guard is not vacuous.

Every $ref points at a contract's canonical schema.json whose $id matches its own directory, and a contract directory contains no undeclared schema-like file, so a permissive decoy cannot be substituted.
Every catalog schema declares additionalProperties: false at its root, and the extra-key guard is not opt-out.
required_tests: Catalog $ref resolvability against disk, and no $ref escaping the catalog
Manifest-declared schema and fixtures exist; every fixture on disk is declared
Draft status preserved for all three new contracts and in the index
Valid/invalid fixture acceptance for CTR-API-001, CTR-PAG-001 and CTR-IDM-001

Negative cases: success payload carried together with an error, decodable offset cursor, sort without a tiebreaker, idempotency scope missing workspace, payload-hash format, completed without result_ref, public reference leakage
Repository protocol, ownership, role-separation, capability and secret-scan checks

Schema conformance: every fixture validated against its own shipped schema.json; an undeclared extra property rejected wherever additionalProperties is false; a reference field rejects all eight hostile scheme forms
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. Reverting restores the two broken $refs exactly and removes the three Draft contract directories and both new test files. No persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect exists.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-002 manual merge is no longer the control. Branch protection on main became real on 2026-09-02 -- required status check, admins included -- and RFC-2026-004 was approved the same day, so the disposition this blocker was waiting for has happened. What remains, and is recorded on every package rather than only here, is that no REQUIRED REVIEW exists: the Product Owner opens the pull requests and GitHub forbids approving your own.

The cross-package correction to two WP-0A-CON-001 outputs requires an acknowledgement countersigned by that package Integration Owner /root/r0_steward, an OpenAI Codex run unavailable in this session. Both schemas record acknowledgement_status pending.

CTR-PAG-001 accepts a forgeable cursor. API-003 calls it "opaque/tamper-safe" but no integrity mechanism exists in the baseline and none is invented here; independent security review demonstrated that base64 of an offset satisfies opacity by inspection. A MAC or signature MUST be specified by the contract owner before freeze. Recorded in accepted_gaps.

CTR-PAG-001 has no page-size bound. None exists in the baseline; an earlier draft invented 100 and it was removed as unsourced. An upper bound is a real enumeration-risk control and is referred to the contract owner.
CTR-API-001 does not constrain the success `data` branch, which carries generated content. Per-command response schemas must constrain it; this envelope cannot. Declared in-schema.
CTR-IDM-001 does not pin a hash algorithm. The baseline names none for this contract; the algorithm-prefixed form is required so it is explicit on the wire, but choosing it is a Security decision.
"No duplicate or missing item between pages" cannot be demonstrated by fixtures and is declared in untestable_by_fixture. It needs a real dataset and a paging harness before freeze.

WP-0A-A0-002 is merged and RFC-2026-003 is approved, so the ownership validator accepts these paths and CI executes the contract tests. This package's remaining dependency risk is not a merge state: it is that the blockers below were written against a catalog that other packages have since changed, and each is re-verified against the tree rather than carried forward.
prefer_cross_vendor_review is not satisfied; see independence.cross_vendor_exception. Recorded as an exception, not waived.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; this package is restricted to reversible, synthetic-only work.

CTR-JOB-001.input_ref and .result_ref now carry the ALLOW-LISTED scheme pattern (^(job|status|result|app|asset|content):...), replacing the deny-list that independent security review proved bypassable at 106f91c. WP-0A-CON-005 made the change against the shipped schema under RFC-2026-006, which is approved. The escalation this blocker recorded was answered by its owner; it is kept in the record because the bypass was real, not because it is open.

The subset validator FAILS CLOSED on any format it does not enforce (test-kits/contracts/json-schema-subset.mjs:123): a schema declaring format 'uri', 'email' or 'uuid' is now rejected rather than silently accepted. Independent review sixteen executed the bypass -- 'uri' accepted 'not a uri at all' -- and the repair was to refuse the keyword, not to implement it. A future schema needing another format must extend the validator in the same commit.

A JWT placed in the declared field tenant_context.actor.id passes every check: it is a string in a declared slot, and the repository secret scanner has no pattern for it. CTR-TEN-001 is owned by WP-0A-CON-001; escalated rather than changed here.
